{\ttfamily weak\allowbreak{}Interface\allowbreak{}Trace\allowbreak{}Min\allowbreak{}Weight} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily m\_\allowbreak{}weak\allowbreak{}Interface\allowbreak{}Trace\allowbreak{}Min\allowbreak{}Weight} & Minimum active trace support weight required on each side of a weak-interface trace projection.\\
{\ttfamily weak\allowbreak{}Interface\allowbreak{}Trace\allowbreak{}Pairs} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily -\allowbreak{}} & Optional contact-group pairs for weak-interface trace projection. Empty means all group pairs.\\

Values greater than one reduce slip without using a full one-shot projection.\\
{\ttfamily weak\allowbreak{}Interface\allowbreak{}Trace\allowbreak{}Projection\allowbreak{}Scale} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily m\_\allowbreak{}weak\allowbreak{}Interface\allowbreak{}Trace\allowbreak{}Projection\allowbreak{}Scale} & Under-relaxation scale alpha for each weak-interface trace projection impulse.\\
{\ttfamily weak\allowbreak{}Interface\allowbreak{}Trace\allowbreak{}Suppress\allowbreak{}Nodal\allowbreak{}Contact} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily m\_\allowbreak{}weak\allowbreak{}Interface\allowbreak{}Trace\allowbreak{}Suppress\allowbreak{}Nodal\allowbreak{}Contact} & Skip ordinary nodal contact for contact-group pairs handled by weak-interface trace projection.\\
